freeze_before_sending: GT bytes/SHA unchanged; do not pass GT, annotated images, answers, counts or evaluated coordinates into prompts.

Existing known attributes only. Catan terrain19 + numeral18; robber/object presence reported separately. Splendor preGT market bonus and points only where preGT has a definite value/confidence, noble points separately; costs UNKNOWN unless already fixed individually. Sagrada occupied-die color17 + top-face17.

Denominator is preGT known physical attributes, not output length. Report correct/wrong/null-or-missing/ambiguous matching and false-positive objects separately. Do not treat an omitted property as 0.

Match physical object from source box/location/visible relative description, independently of predicted value. Identical values do not establish identity. No silent coordinate shifts or GT-driven output permutation. If ambiguous, report unmatched. For backward comparability also report prior reviewer correspondence separately from strict box matching.
Never score Sagrada manual cell/dieZone as missing visual values. No board-slot scoring in B; spatial support is box correspondence only.

Timing is request start to complete response, plus upstream and normalization if measured. Report input/output/reasoning usage, calculated peak cost, actual errors and all attempts. No mean accuracy claims across all120 games.
scoring.decision_rule: Diagnostic support for simpler extraction only if a case has more correct known attributes without more wrong values or false-positive objects, and coverage/matching does not decrease. Otherwise mixed/no gain/UNCLEAR. One sample per condition cannot establish reliability or release readiness.
no_claims: No model weights/vision encoder causality from one A/B.
No B normalization or app success unless separately implemented and tested.
No latency guarantees, per-game general accuracy or global120 accuracy.

inputBound: Prompt UTF8 bytes +10240 conservative image/framing reservation; not official tokenization guarantee; check actual usage and stop on absent/exceeded.
limits: Same high label does not mean equal computation or internal image resolution.
Different provider APIs/JSON modes are explicit, no native app normalization/save claim.
Three photos, one sample/model: no general accuracy guarantee.
No fallback model/API, no hidden retry or continuation.
